description.raw: '''Toggle:''' '''Jinx''' switches between ''[[File:Pow-Pow.png|20xpx|border|link=Jinx#Pow-Pow|An icon representing Jinx#Pow-Pow]] [[Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow]]'', her minigun, and ''[[File:Fishbones.png|20xpx|border|link=Jinx#Fishbones|An icon representing Jinx#Fishbones]] [[Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones]]'', her rocket launcher.
description.text: Toggle: Jinx switches between Pow-Pow, her minigun, and Fishbones, her rocket launcher.

description2.raw: '''Pow-Pow:''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|Basic attacks]] with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
description2.text: Pow-Pow: Basic attacks with Pow-Pow generate a stack of Rev'd up for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with Pow-Pow and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Rev'd up grants  bonus attack speed, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.

description3.raw: '''Fishbones:''' Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] to deal 110% AD '''modified''' physical damage to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] '''bonus''' range but loses [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed.
description3.text: Fishbones: Basic attacks with Fishbones cost  mana on-attack to deal 110% AD modified physical damage to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by critical strike modifiers. While Fishbones is equipped, Jinx gains  bonus range but loses  10% of her bonus attack speed.

description4.raw: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.
description4.text: Only the first attack after switching to Fishbones will benefit from Rev'd up.

notes.text:
Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Despite Jinx starting the game using Pow-Pow she doesn't receive any bonus attack speed until Switcheroo! has been learned.
Fishbones splash damage affects structures (minions will target Jinx) but does not affect targets if Jinx's attacks are blocked, dodged, or missed.
Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury bolts are special-cased to generate one Pow-Pow stack per enemy hit.
Each of Runaan's Hurricane's additional bolts apply Fishbones' splash damage, which stacks with each other.
Both weapons deal basic damage to their primary target (this includes the increased damage of Fishbones), which applies  life steal based on the damage dealt (post-mitigation) as usual.
The splash damage of Fishbones is based on the pre-mitigation damage done to the primary target (which includes critical strikes), and is not considered modified physical damage. It deals default damage and thus doesn't apply  life steal or on-hit effects.
Fishbones' damage calculations:
* Basic attack damage: 110% AD
* Critical strike damage: 220% AD
* Critical strike damage with Infinity Edge: 253% AD
* Runaan's Hurricane's bolt damage: 60.5% AD
* Bolt critical strike damage: 121% AD
* Bolt critical strike damage with Infinity Edge: 139.15% AD
* Maximum potential damage with Runaan's Hurricane: 231% AD
* Maximum potential critical strike damage with Runaan's Hurricane: 462% AD
* Maximum potential critical strike damage with Runaan's Hurricane and Infinity Edge: 531.3% AD

The splash damage of Fishbones is based on the pre-mitigation damage done to the primary target (which includes critical strikes), and is not considered modified physical damage. It deals default damage and thus doesn't apply  life steal or on-hit effects.

* Maximum potential critical strike damage with Runaan's Hurricane: 462% AD
* Maximum potential critical strike damage with Runaan's Hurricane and Infinity Edge: 531.3% AD

description.raw: '''Toggle:''' '''Jinx''' switches between ''[[File:Pow-Pow.png|20xpx|border|link=Jinx#Pow-Pow|An icon representing Jinx#Pow-Pow]] [[Jinx#Pow-Pow|Pow-Pow]]'', her minigun, and ''[[File:Fishbones.png|20xpx|border|link=Jinx#Fishbones|An icon representing Jinx#Fishbones]] [[Jinx#Fishbones|Fishbones]]'', her rocket launcher.

description2.raw: '''Pow-Pow:''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|Basic attacks]] with ''Pow-Pow'' generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] ''Rev'd up'' for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with ''Pow-Pow'' and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of ''Rev'd up'' grants [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.
description2.text: Pow-Pow: Basic attacks with Pow-Pow generate a stack of Rev'd up for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks with Pow-Pow and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Rev'd up grants  bonus attack speed, with all stacks beyond the first one being 50% effective. Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends.

description3.raw: '''Fishbones:''' Basic attacks with ''Fishbones'' cost [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] to deal 110% AD '''modified''' physical damage to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers. While ''Fishbones'' is equipped, '''Jinx''' gains [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] '''bonus''' range but loses [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 10% of her '''bonus''' attack speed.
description3.text: Fishbones: Basic attacks with Fishbones cost  mana on-attack to deal 110% AD modified physical damage to the target and nearby enemies. The damage is affected by critical strike modifiers. While Fishbones is equipped, Jinx gains  bonus range but loses  10% of her bonus attack speed.

description4.raw: ''Only the first attack after switching to [[File:Switcheroo!.png|20px|link=]] Fishbones will benefit from [[File:Rev'd up buff.png|20px]] Rev'd up''.
description4.text: Only the first attack after switching to Fishbones will benefit from Rev'd up.
